messages:
kaya: Noticed a support case where a tenant got charged across v1/v2 during a long websocket session. Looks like routing rebalances caused split attribution.

tom: Yup. The runtime can flip variants mid-session for SLO reasons. Billing currently attributes per-token, so that yields split invoices.

maria: Proposal: introduce a short, server-respected session affinity header `X-Redwood-Session-Id` and default to attributing tokens to the first-seen variant for a configurable grace window (default 30s).

devex-izzy: +1. Also want a Console affordance: per-tenant toggle "Stable billing attribution" with a slider for the grace window and a short tooltip linking to migration docs.

sre-bot: alert: attribution-flip-spike tenant: omega (+7% 45m)

kaya: For telemetry emit `attrib.decision` events (tenant, route, session_hint, decision) at low sample rate so we can correlate spikes without exploding cardinality.

tom: Implementation plan: header + telemetry PR, billing pipeline reads `session_origin_variant` tag if FF `stable_attrib` is on, Console toggle behind FF. We'll gate rollout per-tenant.

maria: Need an admin debug endpoint `/internal/debug/session_attr?session_id=` for SRE to inspect variant timeline when customers dispute invoices. Admin-only.

devex-izzy: I'll draft SDK helper to auto-generate the header and docs + migration FAQ. Also recommend a brief console test page so customers can validate attribution behavior.

kaya: Great. Timeline: PRs this week, FF in staging next week, small cohort rollout after telemetry looks stable.

maria: Thanks team. Let's add a short billing note we can show in Console when toggle on: "Tokens during the grace window are billed to the initial variant to avoid split-session invoices."
